title: Three Children Holding Duck in Backyard, 1965 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white snapshot capture of three young children posed outside in a backyard garden setting, printed in September 1965. The boy on the left holds a large white duck or goose in his arms, while the older boy in the middle wears an unbuttoned short-sleeved shirt and light trousers. A young girl on the right stands casually with her hand on her hip. Behind them is a exterior display window showing decorative plates and ceramics. The photo features deckled edges and a date stamp '. SEP . 65' on the bottom border.
